AutoFlowMate is a Windows desktop and web automation (RPA) tool written in Rust. Flows are plain JSON. You can build them in a visual flowchart editor, run them from the command line, schedule them, or have an AI agent write them.

## Download

**`AutoFlowMate-v0.2.0-windows-x64.zip`** is a portable build with no installer. Unzip it anywhere and run:

- `autoflow-studio.exe`: the visual editor (flowchart, run, schedule)
- `autoflow.exe`: the command line (`run`, `validate`, `schedule`, `inspect`, …)

Keep both files in the same folder. Scheduled tasks call `autoflow.exe`. The `.sha256` file holds the checksum for the zip.

## What's in this release

- **68 actions** for files and folders, programs, windows, mouse, keyboard, Windows UI Automation, image recognition, screen pixels, clipboard, dialogs and control flow.
- **Web automation.** Drive Edge or Chrome by **element id** or CSS selector: type, click, wait, read text, values and attributes, run JavaScript, and take screenshots of the page or of a single element.
- **PyAutoGUI-style tools:**
  - eased mouse moves
  - mouse down/up and key down/up
  - image search with a `confidence` setting
  - `pixel_get` and `pixel_matches`
  - `message_box` and `input_box`
  - a default key delay of 100 ms and a pause after every input, both adjustable per flow, plus per-step delays
- **Fail-safe.** A run stops when you move the mouse into any screen corner or press **Ctrl+Alt+Q**. This works even in the middle of typing.
- **Studio.**
  - a flowchart editor with drag-and-drop
  - a step list and a JSON view
  - an element picker and image snipping
  - a live mouse position display
  - icons for every action
  - a splash screen and an About page
- **Scheduling** through Windows Task Scheduler: daily, weekdays, weekly, monthly, once, every N minutes, or at log-on. Each scheduled run writes its own log.
- **AI skill.** `skills/autoflowmate/SKILL.md` teaches agents such as Claude Code to turn a numbered list of steps into a validated flow.
- **Examples.** File organiser, Calculator through UI Automation, Notepad, TallyPrime Balance Sheet export, an Excel sheet with formulas, a web form, and a PyAutoGUI tour.

## Requirements

- Windows 10 or 11, x64.
- Web actions need Microsoft Edge, which is preinstalled, or Google Chrome.
- Desktop (keyboard and mouse) flows need a logged-in, unlocked session. Windows blocks synthetic input on a locked screen.
